title: Design System: 班级座位表排位系统

body.purpose: Default body text. Used for labels, buttons, inputs, and prose. 14px system font stack.

title.purpose: Panel headings only (h2). 18px semi-bold. Not used in presentation mode.

label.purpose: Seat names, hints, auxiliary text. 12px regular. Legible in dense grid.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Button hover, border transitions, tab switches.

motion.name: ease-bounce
motion.purpose: Bounce pop overshoot. The only overshoot curve in the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button in config mode. Slate blue-gray, white text, 4px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4F5D75; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #4F5D75; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3D4A5F; border-color: #3D4A5F; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Base Button
components.description: Neutral secondary button. White bg, mist-gray border, frost-gray on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-base { background: #fff; color: #404040; border: 1px solid #CCCCCC; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-base:hover { background: #F2F2F2; border-color: #B0BEC5; } .ds-btn-base:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action. Red bg, white text. Used for clear seating plan.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #C62828; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #C62828; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #A01E1E; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Reveal Button (Dark)
components.description: Presentation mode CTA. Sage green on dark #14181E bg. The only accent in dark context.
components.css: .ds-reveal-btn { background: #5B7B6F; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #5B7B6F; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 32px; font-size: 16px; min-width: 200px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, opacity 0.2s; } .ds-reveal-btn:hover { background: #4A6A5E; } .ds-reveal-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Seat (Male)
components.description: Female student seat card. Sky blue bg with matching border, 6px radius.
components.css: .ds-seat-male { width: 80px; height: 44px; background: #E8F0FE; border: 2px solid #A8C8FA; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; color: #1A3A5C; user-select: none; cursor: grab; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; }

components.name: Seat (Female)
components.description: Female student seat card. Rose pink bg with matching border, 6px radius.
components.css: .ds-seat-female { width: 80px; height: 44px; background: #FCE4EC; border: 2px solid #F48FB1; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; color: #5C1A2A; user-select: none; cursor: grab; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; }

components.name: Number Input
components.description: Numeric input for row/col count. Fixed 60px width, 4px radius.
components.css: .ds-input-number { width: 60px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #CCCCCC; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; color: #404040; background: #fff; } .ds-input-number:focus { outline: none; border-color: #4F5D75; }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: Top tab toggle between config and presentation mode.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tab-bar"><button class="ds-tab active">⚙️ 配置</button><button class="ds-tab">🎭 展示</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tab-bar { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 0; background: #F2F2F2; border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E5E5; } .ds-tab { padding: 4px 16px; border: none; background: none; font-size: 14px; color: #6B7280; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #404040; } .ds-tab.active { color: #4F5D75; border-bottom-color: #4F5D75; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: 一个教师在清晨走进教室，阳光透过绿色窗帘洒在灰蓝色墙面上。空气安静，黑板干净，第一排课桌等待着学生的名字。这个工具置身其中：温和、井然有序、不打扰思考。配色系统以石板灰蓝作为主色调，鼠尾草绿作为点缀——两种颜色都源于教室的自然环境。配置模式是教师在办公室的专注工具：浅色背景、清晰分区、操作路径最短。展示模式是课堂上的高光时刻：深色沉浸式背景、唯一的焦点按钮、四种揭晓动画。
keyCharacteristics: 温和中性色偏移，始终带暖色调（无冷灰、纯白、纯黑）
扁平表面静止，阴影仅在交互反馈时出现
小圆角（4px 为主）、清晰边框，工具感为主
配置模式清晰分区，展示模式凝聚焦点
性别色彩（淡蓝 / 淡粉）作为数据可视化，不作为装饰

rules.name: The Accent Discipline Rule
rules.body: 鼠尾草绿仅在展示模式的揭晓按钮上使用。配置模式的所有操作按钮使用石板灰蓝。两个颜色不在同一屏幕上同时作为主操作色。

rules.name: The No Pure Black/White Rule
rules.body: #fff 仅用于白色文字对照在深色按钮上，#000 不出现在任何位置。所有中性色从粉笔白到砚黑都带暖色调偏移。

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: 整个应用使用同一套字体栈。标题不切换字体族，仅通过尺寸和字重区分层次。

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: 字号固定（12/14/16/18/20 px），不使用 clamp() 或 vw 单位。配置模式和展示模式共享相同的文字尺寸。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 表面静止时平坦。阴影仅作为状态响应出现（hover、drag、focus-overlay）。没有任何静态卡片自带投影。

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: 任何屏幕上只有一个按钮使用 primary/accent 背景色。配置模式的生成按钮使用石板灰蓝；展示模式的揭晓按钮使用鼠尾草绿。其余按钮使用 base 或 secondary 样式。

dos: Do 使用 CSS 自定义属性引用颜色（var(--color-*)），不要硬编码颜色值
Do 保持按钮层次：每屏只有一个 primary/accent 按钮
Do 使用系统字体栈，不引入 web font
Do 通过背景色深浅区分层次，阴影仅用于交互反馈
Do 配置模式用石板灰蓝，展示模式用鼠尾草绿作为操作色
donts: Don't 使用纯黑 #000 或纯白 #fff 作为背景色
Don't 引入超过 2px 的 border-left/border-right 作为装饰条纹
Don't 使用 background-clip: text 渐变文字效果
Don't 使用毛玻璃效果（backdrop-filter blur）作为默认卡片样式
Don't 引入儿童化卡通风格：彩虹色、卡通贴纸、过度装饰的圆角
Don't 模仿传统企业后台的深蓝仪表盘配色
Don't 堆叠白色阴影卡片
Don't 在动画中使用 bounce 或 elastic 缓动作为通用过渡
